    """Replace the 3-marked corruption using matching mirrored cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 3:
                # The hidden pattern is mirrored in both axes; choose the
                # corresponding non-corrupted cell where the two axes agree.
                candidates = [
                    grid[h - 1 - r][c],
                    grid[r][w - 1 - c],
                    grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c],
                    grid[w - 1 - c][h - 1 - r] if w == h else 3,
                ]
                vals = [v for v in candidates if v != 3]
                out[r][c] = max(set(vals), key=vals.count) if vals else 3
    return out
